BrochureContent.Content:
The Site at 123 Foxrock Grove consists of a large rear garden to the existing house, which has obtained F.P.P. for a 143sqm bungalow and road access with parking. This represents an outstanding opportunity for investors, builders, or families seeking a multi-generational living solution.

Full Planning Permission was granted on February 2026 (Ref: D25A/0974/WEB) for a detached 3-bedroom bungalow, with attractive pitched-roof design including roof lights and high vaulted ceilings in the main living area. The design includes three generous double bedrooms plus ensuite and main bathroom, a front living room and a rear open plan kitchen-living-dining room, plus separate utility room. The new build would include a private 182 sqm rear garden and two dedicated car parking spaces acessed via shared side access.

Foxrock Grove is a high-demand area where new A-rated 3-bed homes are highly sought after, especially rare bungalows suitable for Step-Free living.

LOCATION
- Located in the heart of Deansgrange, the property is a short stroll from a vibrant village atmosphere.
- Within a 5-minute walk of SuperValu, Lidl, FX Buckley Butchers, and the local Deansgrange Library.
- Further afield are Blackrock and Monkstown Villages, with a great range of shops, cafes and restaurants just a short drive away.
- Premier Schools: Surrounded by top-tier education options including Hollypark National School, Loreto Foxrock, Clonkeen College, and Lycee Francais d'Irlande.
- Outdoors: Minutes from Kilbogget Park and Cabinteely Park, offering vast green spaces, playgrounds, and sports facilities.

TRANSPORT
- Bus Services: Just a 3-minute walk to the Quality Bus Corridor (QBC) on Kill Lane. The E2 route provides a 24-hour service connecting to the city centre, UCD, and Dun Laoghaire.
- Road Networks: Rapid access to the N11 and M50, facilitating easy travel across Dublin and beyond.
- Rail Links: Short drive or bus journey to the DART at Dun Laoghaire or the Luas Green Line at Sandyford/Carrickmines.
